title: hepetis ramosa
intro: Hepetis ramosa, commonly known as Indian hyssop, is a plant species that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hepetis ramosa include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, which helps in relieving respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
